svg.text: THE HONEST PART
Two things Phonak cannot do at any price
Not a budget problem. Spending more does not fix either one.
“I want behind the ear”
Two walls, one person
BTE
behind the ear
Infinio, the latest platform, has no behind-the-ear model.
Behind the ear means Lumity or Terra. Never the newest chip.
Naida L30-PR is rechargeable, but fits 20 to 90 dB.
Naida L30-UP reaches 120 dB, on disposable batteries.
So profound power and rechargeable never meet.
“I want invisible, and rechargeable”
One wall, and it is size
ITC
rechargeable, visible
CIC
invisible, battery only
Phonak's rechargeable custom stops at ITC, which is visible.
Every completely-in-canal Phonak runs on a size 10 battery.
Truly invisible and rechargeable together does not exist.
Both are real limits of the brand. Neither one is a price problem.
Phonak's own renders, in black where the model offers it, sized to approximate real relative scale.
